entity_types: Public association (Law No. 70-V of 3 May 2014, as amended) — formed only with state registration consent via the Ministry of Justice; charitable activity may be conducted without an entity under the Law on Charitable Activity (2017).
cost_time: Fees last published ~86 USD local PA / ~143 national (400+ members) / ~571 international (2004 decree No. 6547, 2010 order, via ICNL 2018); current official fee schedule and processing time unpublished (as of 2026).
foreign_no_presence: no — Law No. 70-V Art. 1: public associations are formed by citizens of Turkmenistan only; no foreign-founder route; foreign aid/programs need state registration (2013 presidential resolution).
corrections: Sources column cites ICNL's Tajikistan page; the Turkmenistan report URL is icnl.org/resources/civic-freedom-monitor/turkmenistan.
